question: Anurag and Bhavna started driving from the same point. Anurag drove North for 11 km, then turns right and covers 13 km. Bhavna goes West and covers 15 km, then turns right and covers 11 km. How far apart are they from each other in a straight line?
solution:
Given: 

Anurag and Bhavna started driving from the same point.

Anurag drove North for 11 km,

then turns right and covers 13 km.

Bhavna goes West and covers 15 km,

then turns right and covers 11 km

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98777c75d038729cba2913c3acb3ea0b499c081e11edbcb96d0e25e5f5b65b02.png] 

So, they are 28km away from each other in a straight line.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
